input.prompt:
Survey the complete operational workflow for managing a live biotech model portfolio via Claude. The existing skills are:

1. `biotech-rebalance` — weekly equal-weight rebalance of account 802349084
2. `biotech-portfolio-status` — read-only health check (value, P&L, drawdown, drift, model alignment)
3. `biotech-roster-check` — top-30 diff vs holdings, rank movers, entry/exit flags
4. `biotech-ira-review` — read-only IRA holdings with P&L and model ranks

The operational rules in memory are:
- Rule 1: Weekly Monday rebalance + 25% drift trigger
- Rule 2: New entries at weekly; exits immediately if rank ≥40
- Rule 3: Equal weight until $5K, then model weight
- Rule 4: Hard exit if drawdown vs XBI ≤ −2pp (full liquidation)
- Rule 5: IRAs manually managed only — no automatic rebalancing

The user also has:
- Biotech screener model at `/mnt/c/Projects/biotech_screener/biotech-screener/data/snapshots/<date>/rankings.csv`
- Broader governance gates: IC health (mean_ic ≥ 0.03), h20d re-eval gate (2026-07-01), 13F Jaccard (≥0.70), EES shadow monitor
- Two IRA accounts (Roth ••••0727, Traditional ••••0174)
- Robinhood MCP tools available

Your task: Identify ALL missing skills needed for complete operational coverage. Think across these scenarios:
- Emergency/safety scenarios
- Governance/compliance checks
- Performance reporting
- Ad-hoc trade execution (outside rebalance cycle)
- Research/diagnostics
- Daily monitoring
- Session startup

For each missing skill, provide:
- Name (kebab-case, biotech- prefix)
- One-line description
- Key steps (bullet points, max 5)
- Tools needed

Be exhaustive. Report as a numbered list. Under 400 words total.
